snippet.title: HALLOW BLADE ► Publishing Announcement Trailer at Top Hat Studios Spring Showcase
snippet.description:
Within the sprawling, interconnected ruins of a once great subterranean kingdom, the HALLOW BLADE hungers for vengeance. HALLOW BLADE is a dark fantasy first person action-adventure, where you assume the role of a wanderer who forms a fateful, unbreakable bond with the titular Hallow Blade; an ancient, possessed sword that hungers for revenge - and souls. Focused on strategic yet fast-paced first-person combat and deep exploration, you are tasked with overcoming the wrath of a cursed kingdom and its denizens. As you hunt powerful foes and feed their souls to your weapon, it evolves, unlocking new forms and abilities  - which alongside other items, prove necessary in your journey to destroy the kingdom’s curse.

Features:
- Strategic first-person combat, emphasizing parrying, dodging, and strafing to overcome foes, alongside a diverse inventory that allows multiple approaches
- An evolving sentient weapon - feed souls of grand foes to the Hallow Blade to strengthen and transform it
- Explore a vast, diverse underworld spanning gigantic kingdoms, luscious forests, overgrown ruins, and more
- Magic rings, new abilities, and nooks and crannies hold the secret to expanding this interconnected dark-fantasy world, and the way you engage with it
- An atmospheric dark fantasy world featuring a grim, immersive setting where lifting the blade means wagering your soul.
